scope: Port policy public API optimization. Production GN integration and quiet timing remain parent-owned.
timing: No benchmark timings collected; no speedup claim.
changes: Validate invalid ports before accessing shared state.
Atomic empty-set hint avoids locking in the common empty explicit-set case; updates happen under the mutex and use release/acquire ordering.
Store the first distinct explicit port inline and retain multiplicities; additional distinct ports use BTreeMap, with a cached total count.
Avoid endpoint state locks for nonlocal addresses and for the initial localhost feature set before a reload or override; keep lazy initialization and first-load/reload double parse.
Use a const-initialized Mutex; feature and invalid-token callbacks remain outside that mutex.
synchronization: Concurrent read-only calls remain safe; explicit mutations and reload are sequenced under the mutex. Atomic hints only skip the lock when the guarded state has no relevant value; a read racing with a mutation can linearize before that mutation. The original API did not support unsynchronized concurrent mutation.
generated_code: Generated CXX wrapper uses a tail jump to the Rust cxxbridge function in inspected fuzz-instrumented object. It does not eliminate the C++/Rust boundary; no unsupported bridge-cost attribution.
unchanged: Frozen reference algorithms, perftest inputs and timing loops, production C++ adapter (including guarded token view), feature instrumentation, histogram order and platform service seams. No GN change required.

validation.differential: 2 passed, including 1,000,000 deterministic state sequences and concurrent read-only access
validation.fuzzer: 1,000,000 executions, up to 48 bytes, CPU 6; final source; includes out-of-order exception destruction and duplicate overflow entries
validation.lint: configured rust-toolchain Clippy with -D warnings passed
validation.format: rustfmt --check and clang-format --dry-run --Werror passed; rustfmt reported local unstable config-option warnings
validation.coverage_note: Runtime Rust authored lines and regions; no branch coverage collected. Generated glue and C++ not included.
validation.native_build: Isolated scratch, configured toolchain and DLLs; test harness statically links frozen reference using IS_PORT_POLICY_REFERENCE_IMPL and does not represent canonical separate-DLL production build.

limitations: No new quantitative timing, benchmark measurements or chart updates.
No configured GN/Ninja build; parent must synchronize owned files, rebuild and validate.
Parent must remeasure every case in a coordinated quiet window and import all results; the inline representation may affect reset or multi-port workloads, so gains and regressions remain unknown.
The native harness has a static reference boundary; accepted results were measured across separate component DLLs.
Callback services and Rust state remain FFI and synchronization seams; no numerical inference about their individual costs.
source_flags: unit-rsp/fuzz-rsp and corresponding link command, build_native.py, and Rust build logs; instrumentation is used for unit coverage and fuzz builds.
